Part 1 高频 物品 OBJECTS

Scenery

风景

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Do you look out the window at the scenery when travelling by bus or car?

Yes, almost always. When I travel by bus or car, I love watching the scenery pass by, especially the fields and villages in the countryside. It's a great way to kill time, and sometimes the views are genuinely stunning.

坐车坐公交超爱看窗外风景，尤其田野村庄。

Q2Do you prefer the mountains or the sea?

Definitely the sea. I find the sea more relaxing, with the sound of waves and the open horizon, and Shenzhen has plenty of seaside spots to enjoy. Mountains are nice for hiking, but the sea just calms me down.

更喜欢海，海浪和开阔海平线让人放松。

Q3Do you like to take scenery pictures?

Yeah, I really enjoy it. When I travel, I take lots of scenery photos, like mountains, seas and city skylines, mostly with my phone. Looking back at them later always brings back nice memories of the trip.

旅行爱拍风景照，山、海、城市天际线都拍。

Q4What are the most beautiful sights you have seen while travelling?

The most beautiful sight I've seen is Jilong Mountain in Yangjiang. I went there with my girlfriend, and the grassland on the mountaintop was just breathtaking, with the clouds rolling below us. I took a ton of photos that day.

见过最美的风景是阳江鸡笼顶，和女朋友一起，山顶草地云海很震撼。
